title: A stranger's sister Circle no longer lands inside someone else's Space, and a hidden Circle cannot be copied by its id

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), Circles review of #3201 (LIVE-665).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: seedSisterCircleAction gated only on the offer (a full Circle plus not a member) and the create gate, and seedSisterCircle copied the source's space_id, access and hub_id into a draft the caller hosts. Any signed-in member could start a Circle inside a Space they had no role in, skipping requireSpaceEditor and the Space Circle meter that the proper door applies; once published its events stamped onto the Space's calendar and Space members read its announcements. The action read the source with the admin client, so a raw id of a full private or unlisted Circle copied its location, about and agreements. THE FIX: the action refuses a Circle the caller cannot read under their own session (the restrictive can_see_circle policy), and the sister keeps the source's Space, access and Hub only for the source's host or one of its Space's editors; anyone else's sister lands on the root Space, open, like a remix.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/circles/remix-actions.ts','utf8');const s=fs.readFileSync('lib/circles/sister.ts','utf8');const miss=[];if(!/if \(!visible\) throw new Error/.test(a))miss.push('the sister action copies a Circle the caller cannot see');if(!/input\.keepPlacement/.test(s)||/space_id: src\.space_id,\n\s+hub_id: src\.hub_id,\n\s+topical_channel_id/.test(s))miss.push('a stranger\'s sister inherits the source Space');if(miss.length){console.error('SCAN-825: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
